notConfigured: JKNet accounts and friends need JKNet Online. It is not open yet, so this version keeps the feature switched off. A later update turns it on by itself.

card.title: Account
card.text: A JKNet account carries your friends list and your invites. It is not needed to play.

providers.continueJkhubNote: The account most of the community already has.
providers.continueDiscordNote: Signs you in with the Discord you play with.

waiting.title: Waiting for the browser…
waiting.text: Finish signing in there, then come back to JKNet.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.saved: Saved. Other players see this name.
displayName.rules: 3 to 24 characters: letters, digits, spaces, _ and -.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.signOutText: Keeps the account. Your clients and library stay where they are.
danger.deleteText: Removes the account, your friends and your invites from the service.
danger.confirmBody: Your account, your friends list and your invites are removed from the service. Your clients, your library files and your settings stay on this machine. This cannot be undone.

url.label: JKNet Online address
url.signedIn: Sign out before pointing JKNet at another service.
url.notConfigured: For developers and self-hosted instances: an http:// or https:// address switches accounts and friends on for this machine.
url.hint: An http:// or https:// address. Leave it empty to go back to the default.

session.expiredText: Sign in again on the Settings screen to see your friends.
session.timedOut: The sign-in took too long. Try again.
